name: How long does a typical galvanized pipe replacement take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical galvanized pipe replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a galvanized pipe replacement project can vary significantly based on the size of your home and the complexity of its plumbing system. A smaller home might take a few days, while a larger, more complex residence could require a week or more. The most significant factor impacting timing is the extent of wall or ceiling opening needed to access and replace the old pipes. Our plumbers provide a detailed timeline after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replacement time varies from a few days to over a week, depending on home size, plumbing complexity, and the extent of wall access required.
